feature: Customer Portal v2 -- MICROSOFT CHANGES (/portal-v2/ms-changes), recreated from 'Microsoft Changes.dc.html', a file that did not exist in the round-one handoff. A density grid over eleven uneven time buckets grouped into five waves, the tenant's own freeze windows drawn over it, and ten Message Center posts read against the tenant rather than forwarded. Each post carries Microsoft's own words beside the tenant's answer, the Graph/PowerShell evidence behind that answer, and a written consequence of doing nothing.
notes: THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL. /portal-v2/* sits behind ProtectedRoute.
UI ROUTE SHAPE: /portal/{slug}/portal-v2/ms-changes/{wave}. App.tsx declares '/portal-v2/ms-changes/:wave' BEFORE '/portal-v2/ms-changes', and both before '/portal-v2/:pillar'.
shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree.

THE WAVE SLUGS ARE NOT THE PROTOTYPE'S KEYS. The prototype's wave keys are index STRINGS ('0'…'4', shell 8843). Readable slugs are used instead -- late-august / september / q2 / q3 / beyond -- because this is a URL a customer is meant to be able to send to a colleague. MSC18 pins the mapping so a future reindex cannot silently move a wave.

ROUND TWO, ITEM 6 AND WHAT IT DOES NOT COVER. The changelog de-scrolled 'the Change Control CR/Microsoft-changes Gantt rows'. The density ROWS here are the fluid repeat(11,1fr) shape with no min-width floor and no scroll wrapper, which is that change. The WAVE BAND above them KEEPS its overflow-x:auto + min-width:820px, because the prototype still carries both (Microsoft Changes.dc.html 165-166) and the changelog names the rows. Reproducing the band's scroll is faithful, not an oversight -- eleven month columns plus a 190px label genuinely need the width.

THE COUNTS ARE DERIVED FROM THE DENSITY FIXTURE, NOT STORED. Wave totals are 35 / 80 / 100 / 45 / 22, summed from six workload rows x eleven buckets. MSC6-MSC9 read them off the DOM, which is what proves the sum happens rather than being typed in.

A POST'S BUCKET IS NOT ITS MONTH. `month` indexes a twelve-month calendar; the density grid indexes eleven UNEVEN buckets (three fortnights, six months, two quarters). MC1042318 is month 1 and bucket 2. Deriving one from the other would put items in the wrong column; MSC14 pins that MC1042318 appears under the September wave and not the Late August one.
THERE IS NO NEGATIVE TEXT ASSERTION IN THIS HARNESS, and an array in `textContains` is ANY-of, not all-of (UiTestExecutor.cs:570, :1282). Every all-of assertion here is its own step.
NO `select` STEPS. UiTestExecutor.cs cannot drive a native <select>, and an unknown action silently PASSES. This page has none in the flow asserted here.

NOT BUILT, AND NOT ASSERTED: the 'Did this release?' retrospective, the seen-in-the-wild list, the per-group impact panel, and the thread / snooze / decision overlays. Each is its own subsystem in the prototype and none is named by the Round Two or Round Three changelog. Listed here so this manifest is not read as full module coverage.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.
